from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689794/attempts/a536beb1a07649f1b9f85ee1d72dd80c/system/state/workspace/programs/task-74f9bf92.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marked = [(r, next((v for v in row if v != 0), 0)) for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row)]
    period = len(marked)
    by_residue = {}
    for r, color in marked:
        by_residue[r % period] = color
    return [[by_residue[r % period] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
p.write_text(code)
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',p); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
# demo represented by marked row locations/colors, validate inferred expected cycle

for r,c in [(6,4),(7,8),(9,6),(14,3),(22,6),(23,5)]: x[r]=[c]*27
y=mod.transform(x)
print([row[0] for row in y])
test=[[0]*22 for _ in range(22)]
for r,c in [(2,9),(12,2),(15,4),(17,9),(18,7),(20,6),(21,6)]: test[r]=[c]*22
out=mod.transform(test)
